newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zairean troops said to loot Mobutu village.
newsitem.headline: Zairean troops said to loot Mobutu village.

text.p: Zairean soldiers, retreating from rebel advances, have gone on rampage and looted the village of President Mobutu Sese Seko's northern jungle palace at Gbadolite, a regional military source said on Tuesday.
The source, who closely monitors Africa's latest war, told Reuters the soldiers were mainly those who fled from the towns of Gemena and Businga as rebels approached. He said looting began on Monday.

The source said even some members of Mobutu's elite presidential guard drawn from his Ngbandi tribe and related ethnic groups from his Equateur region joined in the looting -- usually an indicator in Zaire that a place is about to fall.
"They have gone on rampage in Gbadolite. They started looting on Monday and we understand the place is now thoroughly looted," said the source.
Kabila's rebels are closing in on the capital Kinshasa and on Gbadolite, an army outpost well-equipped with military hardware. Kabila says his forces will be in Kinshasa in the next day or two.
